description: Implementation of a Timer class and factory functions for creating timers, including thread management and callback execution.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a timer that executes a callback after a specified timeout, supporting periodic execution.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Timer instances, managing singleton access.

classes.name: ITimerFactory
classes.description: Interface for TimerFactory, providing a method to get the factory instance.

classes.name: ITimer
classes.description: Interface for Timer objects, defining common timer operations.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton TimerFactory instance.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer object with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timer with a timeout, callback, and timer type, starting the timer thread.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the timer, stopping its execution and joining the thread if necessary.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the timer is currently active.
